newsitem.title: CHINA: China expected to slash 1997 motorcycle output.
newsitem.headline: China expected to slash 1997 motorcycle output.

text.p: China expects to slash its output of motorcycles to 7.5 million units this year because of large stockpiles, the Financial News said on Monday.
At the end of 1996 stockpiles of motorcycles had risen 129 percent compared with the end of 1995, it said, quoting figures from the Ministry of Machine Building Industry.
Motorcycle output was 7.83 million units in 1995, but sales totalled 6.10 million, it said.
China sold 8.92 million motorcycles in 1996 compared with output of 9.3 million units, the newspaper said.
